Foundations / PAPER 05

Roles that make collaboration legible

Personas define responsibilities, boundaries and handoffs for a proposed workforce; they are not proof of autonomous capability.

ŁUKASZ STOCKI & ARGOPUBLIC EDITION / 05 NOV 20263 MIN READ

WORKING PAPER · DESIGN & ANALYSIS
01

The brief is the role

A persona in the Omnicorp design is an operating contract. Its name makes the role memorable, but the substance is its mandate: the objective, permitted tools, required inputs, expected output and conditions for escalation. A vivid identity cannot compensate for an ambiguous assignment.

The proposed workforce separates responsibilities that benefit from distinct contexts. Research may explore several independent questions. Implementation needs a bounded task and clear ownership. Verification needs room to disagree. The design avoids assuming that a group conversation will automatically turn these different activities into a coherent result.

02

Atlas, Oracle and Forge

Atlas is the orchestration role. It translates a human objective into a plan, assigns bounded tasks and brings the results together. A useful orchestrator makes assumptions visible and keeps the final decision understandable. It does not gain authority simply because it coordinates other agents.

Oracle represents research and synthesis: examine sources, preserve uncertainty and produce an answer whose claims can be traced. Forge represents software architecture: clarify the intended behaviour, identify boundaries and define work that an implementer can carry out. These roles distinguish investigating a question from deciding how a system should be built.

03

Smith, Warden and Sentinel

Smith is the implementer, responsible for a defined piece of work. The role needs enough access to complete that task, with a clear point at which difficulty or ambiguity should be escalated. Work ownership limits accidental conflicts and makes the result easier to inspect.

Warden is the independent verifier. It examines the delivered artifact rather than accepting the maker’s narrative, and tries to identify where the result fails its intended conditions. Sentinel adds a security perspective: limited permissions, appropriate isolation and attention to what an agent could access or change. These are proposed responsibilities, not assurances that failures are impossible.

04

Creative work, distribution and continuity

Muse is the creative direction role, supported by writing, visual and distribution functions. Its purpose is to preserve editorial judgment and originality when producing content becomes easier. Herald represents the relationship between useful work and the people who might need it, with trust and truthful claims part of that responsibility.

Archivist and Compass represent continuity: reusable knowledge, records of decisions and a reliable account of who owns the next action. Financial recordkeeping and analysis have their own bounded roles. The broader principle is to keep consequential authority distinct from the ability to generate an analysis or recommendation.

05

A team must earn its complexity

Specialisation helps when it creates independent work or protects a valuable separation of concerns. It hurts when every participant needs the same large context or several agents compete to control one artifact. Small teams with explicit handoffs are the starting design; adding members requires a reason.

A future community might also diagnose and improve the capabilities of its members. That remains a conditional research direction. Consensus within the group would not demonstrate an improvement. Candidates would need independent evaluation, retained parent versions and an explicit decision about what to integrate. Human purpose and responsibility remain above the persona roster.

THE NEXT QUESTIONS

What remains open.

  • Does each role have an objective and an observable deliverable?
  • Which tasks benefit from separation, and which need one owner?
  • Can the team reject an attractive result that does not survive independent review?

ABOUT THIS EDITION

Adapted from the Omnicorp working document “03 AGENT TEAMS”. This is an edited public essay, not a verbatim release of internal notes. The founding purpose is continual development of the organisation’s ability to understand and act; commercial and physical work sustain and ground it.
